desc: How Bitcoin achieves consensus without a central authority — Nakamoto Consensus and beyond.

On Bitcoin consensus (thread 2)

@Excellion: "Consensus" in Bitcoin is one word doing seven jobs. Almost every fight you've watched is two people using different definitions, each assuming the other is arguing in bad faith.

Consensus is not agreement. It's a wide range of self-interested actors, node runners, miners,
